response: Event Order API (POS) works by receiving order messages (OMF) from a customer when an order is confirmed and has stock allocation, typically 1 to 4 days before the due collection date. The API validates the order, plans it into optimized TMS routes, and triggers back a route informing how and when the order will be collected. It supports sending new orders, updates, and cancellations to keep the TMS order book current. The endpoint for both UAT and PROD is POST /Oasis/omf.
